source: 2081. A period of unceasing rain transforms the region into a shallow sea. Here, between endless horizons of fresh water, stilted on top of the concrete structures of the past, is the village of Aslandia. Like a society on lillypads, large huts and shanties are interconnected by makeshift bridges, docks, piers, and small boats built from the trees of the nearby pine forest shooting up through the water. When the men return from hunting seal and diving for oyster, and the women have finished weaving rope and salting fish, the elders build a great fire to tell stories of the past. Stories about the strange things below the surface, buried in the mud. Like cars, computers, and silly green papers called "money."
target: 2081 年。连绵不止的雨，将这片地区变成浅海。在无尽的淡水地平线之间，阿斯兰迪亚村架在昔日的混凝土建筑上。如同浮在睡莲上的社会，大茅屋与棚舍由临时桥梁、码头、栈桥与小船相连；建材来自附近穿出水面的松林。男人猎海豹、潜水采蚝归来，女人织完绳索、腌好鱼，长老便燃起大火，讲述过去的故事。那些沉在水面下、埋在泥里的奇怪东西——汽车、电脑，还有叫作「钱」的可笑绿纸。

source:
2051. The unexpected collapse of modern society from a digital apocalypse spurs violence, chaos, and rule by force. Asbury Pines grows unrecognizable. Roads crumble, buildings burn, sewers overflow, shops are looted, and many homes are dark and cold. Smart phones, microwaves, indoor plumbing, law and order – all are dreams of the past. Collective survival becomes the goal. Some Pinies stay boarded-up in the suburbs, but many gather downtown and help erect fortifications around town hall, Asbury Gas, and the Recreation Center.

In these troubling times, characters rely on resources from the past to "live life." The Production Flow tab shows the amount of resources flowing to this era from the past.
target:
2051 年。数位末日令现代社会意外崩溃，催生暴力、混乱与武力统治。阿斯伯里松林镇变得面目全非。道路崩坏、建筑燃烧、污水溢流、商店遭抢，许多住宅黑暗而寒冷。智慧型手机、微波炉、室内水管、法律与秩序，全成了往日梦境。共同生存成为目标。有些松林镇民仍封住郊区住家的门窗，但许多人聚集市中心，协助在镇公所、阿斯伯里加油站及休闲中心周围筑起防御工事。

在这动荡的时代，角色仰赖过去的资源「度过人生」。生产流动分页会显示从过去流入这个时代的资源数量。

source:
1969. Asbury Pines ain't a place of giant leaps for mankind, but powerful forces persist among the townies. A legendary law man, a criminal enterprise, and a psychedelic cult grapple to shape the communities of a thriving town. The new highways connecting to old Route 25 brings many new faces, and whether it's bustling downtown or the wheat fields on the outskirts, it seems they all want a place for themselves.

As key stories are unlocked, their importance emerges in the Quest Tree. From the murder of Everly Praetis to something much more, threads spin, braid, and weave into a grand narrative tapestry, story by story, section by section. A grand design. Destiny unfolds...
target:
1969 年。阿斯伯里松林镇并不是人类迈出巨大跃进的地方，但镇民之间仍有强大势力持续角力。一位传奇警长、一个犯罪组织与一个迷幻教派，争相塑造这座繁荣城镇的社群。新公路接上旧 25 号公路，带来许多新面孔；不论在热闹市中心，还是镇郊麦田，似乎人人都想占有自己的一席之地。

关键故事解锁后，它们的重要性会在任务树中浮现。从艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯命案，到远远超出命案的事物，一条条线索纺成丝、编成股，再一篇篇、一段段织成宏大的叙事挂毯。一幅宏伟蓝图。命运逐渐展开……

source:
2025. Asbury Pines is a quiet town nestled in the thick of a vast pine forest. You blink and you'd miss its exit off of old Route 25, and you'd never know the place ever existed. But life as we know it hums along here in the heart of America. In many ways, the town appears as familiar as it is forgettable. What sort of destiny can this place ever hope to hold?

Select Live Life on the Sheriff to begin unlocking his story – a thread in a grand tapestry. As more town characters emerge, have them Scavenge resources, Work to refine those resources, and convert the refined resources into Experience that enables you to unravel more of their lives.
target:
2025 年。阿斯伯里松林镇，是一座藏在广大茂密松林中的宁静小镇。只要眨个眼，就会错过旧 25 号公路上的出口，永远不知道这里存在过。然而，在这美国腹地，我们熟悉的生活仍平稳运转。从许多方面看，这座镇既熟悉，又容易被遗忘。这样的地方，究竟能承载什么命运？

在警长身上选择「度过人生」，开始解锁他的故事——宏大挂毯中的一条丝线。随着更多镇民出现，让他们拾荒取得资源，再工作加工，将加工后的资源转成经验值，进一步揭开他们的人生。

source: A corrupt and colonizing empire consumes itself, and then black clouds of ash choke the land. A new environment is arid with dust and death. The remaining tribe clusters huts and shanties around fortified ruins called the Ringfort, which protects the locals' greatest resource: a well of water. Children are taught to always listen for the Ringfort's bell, for there is but one certainty in this life: raiders will attack. Though a sect devoted to memorizing past knowledge offers visions of progress, the most savage warriors are the ones who lead. They plunder the borders and bring meat. The kind only the starving would eat without question.
target: 腐败的殖民帝国自我吞噬，随后灰烬的黑云窒息了大地。新的环境干旱，充斥尘土与死亡。残存部落将茅屋与棚舍聚集在一座称为环堡的防御废墟周围；堡垒守护着当地最珍贵的资源：一口水井。孩子从小就被教导，随时留意环堡钟声，因为人生只有一件事确定——劫掠者一定会来。虽然有个致力背诵过往知识的教派，描绘着进步愿景，但真正领导人们的，是最野蛮的战士。他们掠夺边境，带回肉。只有饿极了的人，才会不加追问就吃下的那种肉。

source:
1999. Pinies know their town isn't perfect, but there are plenty of simple things to enjoy. Thursday specials at Dory's Diner, potlucks at St. Francis Church, summer pools at the Recreation Center, and hiking trails snaking through Pine Hills Park to nearby Mt. Ulysses. As technology slowly pervades more of life, and the internet brings whole libraries to fingertips, there is a hint of optimism shared by the locals: maybe things will keep getting better.

Characters can be assigned to research Religions, Governments, and Sciences that unlock strategic Perks: a range of character skill, resource output, and resource production bonuses.
target:
1999 年。松林镇民知道，自己的镇并不完美，但仍有许多简单的乐趣：多莉餐馆的周四特餐、圣方济各教堂的百乐餐、休闲中心的夏日泳池，还有蜿蜒穿过松丘公园、通往附近尤里西斯山的健行步道。科技慢慢深入生活，网际网路将整座图书馆送到指尖，镇民之间也弥漫着一丝乐观：也许一切会越来越好。

可以指派角色研究宗教、政体与科学，解锁具有策略价值的加成，包括各种角色技能、资源产量及生产效率奖励。

source: Once fragmented, knowledge of the past is pieced together to spark an era of unprecedented human progress. When learning is a right and not a privilege, when empathy is the royal decree, when community empowerment is the ultimate goal — the Second Renaissance is born. The people of Quent, from the sewer scrubbers under the streets to the Exomnus Scholars in the tower of the Libraria Rotunda, all hold equal value and dignity. In such a society, human potential is unleashed and exceeds all previous measures. For the first time ever, life's greatest mysteries are within our grasp.
target: 曾经支离破碎的过往知识，逐渐重新拼合，点燃前所未有的人类进步时代。当学习是权利，而非特权；当同理心成为王室敕令；当赋予社群力量成为终极目标——第二次文艺复兴就此诞生。昆特人民，从街道下清理下水道的工人，到圆厅图书馆高塔中的艾克索姆语学者，都拥有平等的价值与尊严。在这样的社会里，人类潜力得以释放，超越过往一切尺度。生命最深奥的谜团，有史以来第一次触手可及。

source: 2121 - Swamp and mud as far as the eye can see in the wake of dissipating waters. An expansionist, snail-based empire brings its culture, religion, and laws at spear-point to the locals, who bear witness to unimaginable opulence and oppression. As the Aslandians toil and live in a district of hovels, the main roads fill with giant snails bred as steeds for war, nobles, and pulling great stones to build palaces, markets, and dens of every dark drug and pleasure. At the end of the day, those with pockets full of the red shell currency will have the easiest lives.
target: 2121 年——洪水退去后，放眼望去尽是沼泽与泥泞。一个以蜗牛为根基、向外扩张的帝国，用矛尖将文化、宗教与法律强加于当地人，也带来难以想像的奢华与压迫。阿斯兰迪亚人辛苦劳动，住在陋屋区；主要道路上则满是巨型蜗牛，有的被培育为战争或贵族坐骑，有的拖运巨石，建造宫殿、市场，以及提供各种阴暗毒品与享乐的巢穴。到头来，口袋里装满红色贝币的人，日子才最轻松。

source:
1874 - Reconstruction policies after the Civil War and a long-lasting worldwide recession have brought opportunists to the growing town of Asbury. Immigrants seeking work, entrepreneurs pitching their visions, and shadowy groups trying to influence social order. Blood, not money, is the more important currency in this time of great public works and community divison.

The timeline of the old town continues to expand. Quickly flip to different Eras by using the hotkeys on the Era tabs in the bottom-right corner of your screen.
target:
1874 年——南北战争后的重建政策，以及长期的全球经济衰退，将投机者带进日益成长的阿斯伯里镇。寻找工作的移民、推销愿景的企业家，还有试图左右社会秩序的地下团体。在这公共建设蓬勃、社群却分裂的年代，鲜血比金钱更具分量。

老镇的时间轴持续扩展。使用画面右下角时代分页上的快捷键，即可快速切换不同时代。

source: 1924. Ideology abounds. Across Prohibiton, a Great Depression, and post-war booms, the townies of Asbury find ways to make sense of rapid change. Some seek solace in the liquored jazz clubs of "Divine" Pine Street, others in the strict observance of religion and law, and some in the pursuit of new intellectual heights. As it turns out, some perspectives will last longer than others. Resonating into the future in subtle yet profound echoes.
target: 1924 年。各种意识形态百花齐放。历经禁酒令、大萧条与战后繁荣，阿斯伯里镇民寻找理解快速变迁的方法。有人在「神圣」松树街酒香弥漫的爵士俱乐部寻求慰藉，有人严守宗教与法律，也有人追求新的思想高峰。结果证明，有些观点比其他观点更加长久，以微妙而深刻的回声，在未来持续共鸣。

source: 1731 - By the western edge of of British colonial America, the Puritan hamlet of Bancroft is turned into a key outpost for the thriving fur trade in the region. The oldest pilgrims no longer recognize this place of commerce, law, and the sin they bring. The town searches for its identity in the tension of change and in the strife to control its own way of life, its independence.
target: 1731 年——在英属美洲殖民地的西缘，清教徒小村班克罗夫特，成为本区蓬勃毛皮贸易的重要据点。最年长的朝圣者，已认不出这片充满商业、法律及随之而来的罪恶的地方。小镇在变革的紧张氛围中寻找身分，也为掌握自己的生活方式、自己的独立而争斗。

source: 9750 BCE - The time of giant sloths and mega-fauna eventually gives way to the era of the pines. Ancient peoples settle the region with different languages, customs, and traditions. But they all form an indelible bond with land. A connection so deep that it shapes the times to come.
target: 西元前 9750 年——巨树懒与大型动物的年代，终将让位给松林时代。古老族群带着不同语言、习俗与传统，在此定居，却都与土地建立无法抹灭的连结。这份羁绊如此深刻，塑造了往后的时代。

source: Great Snahoon and Mighty Emya roamed earth eons ago. From their trails of life-bringing slime (Gloppa) the earth grew forests, fields, and animals. May your prayers rise to meet them on the sacred smoke of your burning hair.
target: 伟大的斯纳洪与强大的艾米雅，曾在久远年代漫游大地。牠们留下带来生命的黏液轨迹（格洛帕），大地因而长出森林、田野与动物。愿你的祈祷随焚烧头发的神圣烟雾升起，抵达祂们身旁。
